## [0.4.1](releases/Snip-Snap-0.4.1.md) - 2026-08-31

- Fix a scroll feedback loop that could make Snip Snap use high CPU and memory.
- Keep list section titles visible while showing their glass surface only when pinned.

## [0.4.0](releases/Snip-Snap-0.4.0.md) - 2026-08-31

- Search saved snips and clipboard items with the same clear controls.
- Use the same card actions and selection behavior across both panels.
- Drag cards and attachments with more reliable file exports.
- Get clearer help when Snip Snap needs Accessibility access.
- Resize and move panels with more consistent edge controls.

## [0.3.0](releases/Snip-Snap-0.3.0.md) - 2026-08-26

- Use clearer names for snips and lists across the app.
- Choose from a wider set of icons when you set up a list.
- Watch the clipboard without an unneeded Accessibility prompt.
- Reorder Inbox snips without jumps or misplaced cards.
- Keep the Inbox window size and position between launches.
- Edit card attachments with more reliable add and remove actions.

## [0.2.0](releases/Snip-Snap-0.2.0.md) - 2026-08-25

- Paste images into the composer and card editor.
- Edit longer text with a larger, smoother multiline field.
- Drop files onto a card while editing it.
- Pick from 300 section icons with search and category filters.
- Get clearer help when selection capture needs Accessibility access.
- Keep the inbox steady during fast scrolling.
- Tell development copies apart with a bright build badge.
